body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.TypeInitializationException`
**Message:** The type initializer for 'System.Resources.Extensions.BinaryFormat.BinaryFormattedObject' threw an exception.

### Stack Trace
```
   at new System.Resources.Extensions.BinaryFormat.BinaryFormattedObject(Stream stream, Options options)
   at object System.Resources.Extensions.DeserializingResourceReader.ReadBinaryFormattedObject()
   at object System.Resources.Extensions.DeserializingResourceRead...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @BrankoH,

This crash is caused by a known .NET 10 issue with binary resource deserialization (`BinaryFormattedObject`). Your build version `1.80.2.3424` is an older nightly — this has been addressed in newer builds.

Please download the latest nightly from [Releases](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly) — it should show version **1.82.0-beta.3** in Help → About. 

If the crash persists on the new build, please let us know!

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: This is the classic .NET 8+ removal of `BinaryFormatter`. If you upgrade to the nightly build it ships the replacement serializer path (see commit `ffdd4b4b3` area and the `BinaryFormat` compatibility shim). Please retry on the latest nightly and let us know whether the initializer still throws.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: Addressed on `main` (see earlier comment for commit refs). Closing as resolved; please reopen with a fresh stack trace / log snippet if it reproduces on the latest [nightly](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly).
